identity.title: Selected SIWC registration handoff and isolated non-dispatch preflight
identity.objective: Implement only the dormant Windows-source/Linux-VM selected-registration bridge and isolated preflight software under later independent exact-byte certification and Karl authorization; synthetic tests only, no operational credential authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert exactly eleven declared repo paths; do not touch real credential storage, pending markers, host, pin, history or prior certificates. Operator credential recovery is separately authorized and never a Git rollback.

api_matrix.reason: Same native module and original route; Windows source only, Linux VM destination. The supplied independently inspected promotion report records the approved Linux profile hermes-profile:sha256:31176884c6fc112a92096c09add7403c3ad75d8578d1ec840e4609ddb2f9744f, 64 installed distributions, 63 actual audited registry requirements with zero known findings and no ignores, native empty/default controls, and PR251 active/bound/current at its recorded observation. Reuse that completed evidence; do not reinstall or replay promotion. It does not prove new SIWC bridge credential behavior, new-code scratch acceptance or real entitlement, and this drafting session does not renew host currentness.

items.before: Callable login/preflight exist; fixed temp writer and no selected VM import or common refresh lock.
items.after: One common credential protocol with confined Windows source and POSIX Linux destination stores and native child-held locks; selected transfer APIs and same-module CLI reuse canonical preflight/evaluator.
items.compatibility_requirement: Existing public method signatures, route, profile, dispatch IDs/journal and evaluator remain; real unsupported-platform use refuses before credentials; no account picker or fallback. The native-phase contract below expressly preserves fail-closed no-record caller behavior; it does not make the excluded production caller operational.

items.surface: Windows source storage/ACL/locking and selected export
items.before: Native login callable exists but no protected Windows storage/lock/export contract is implemented.
items.after: Windows Source Contract: source login/export only, non-elevated user and local NTFS persistent ACLs. Use stdlib ctypes, CreateFileW no-follow reparse handles and parent handles without delete sharing, handle identity/volume/single-link checks, protected explicit owner-SID/SYSTEM-only DACL at creation and GetSecurityInfo validation; reject unsafe/inherited/null/broad ACLs and untrusted ancestor mutation. Deny reparse/junction, UNC/non-NTFS/device/ADS/ambiguous paths; canonical handle-based excluded-root confinement. Fixed never-deleted lock file plus LockFileEx exclusive/fail-immediately, held by credential child; no PID/time stealing or source refresh/catalogue/inference. CREATE_NEW random temps, checked FlushFileBuffers/publication, exact post-publication identity/ACL/length/hash and durable pending/commit/retirement state; no ACL-ignore or unsupported ReplaceFileW write-through flag. Windows export must obey the exact W1 barrier,
items.compatibility_requirement: publication and restart rows below. No weaker durability or read-back proof is allowed. Existing user ACLs are never repaired or elevated. Unsupported capabilities/ambiguous flush/rename/ACL/crash remain blocked, no orphan adoption/retry/rollback. New and replacement generations follow R002 and preserve token-set atomicity. No generic framework/new dependency/module; all R001-R005 semantics remain. Separately assessed Windows source-only variant; no WSL/headless callback assumption, Windows VM/preflight support or waiver of destination guarantees. No Win32 probe ran here.

items.before: Revision B left this Windows retirement/publication/restart ordering unspecified.
items.after: ACTIVE admits no interrupted mutation. Bind one selected bundle in child memory only. Before ANY new secret-bearing export file: CREATE_NEW immutable private PENDING, then RETIRED, each with explicit protected DACL, synchronous noninheritable share=0 no-follow FILE_FLAG_WRITE_THROUGH handle; checked full WriteFile, FlushFileBuffers, same-object pathname/ID/owner/ACL/link/content checks. Never use temporary/delete-on-close attributes. Retirement linearizes only after RETIRED barrier; retain both records permanently. Any collision/short write/flush/check failure blocks, no overwrite/delete/retry. Only the original lock-owning invocation may publish after retirement.
items.compatibility_requirement: Private state record keys exactly schema_id/schema_version/state/operation_alias/selected_generation/registration_binding/source_host_binding/destination_host_binding/export_digest/target_binding; schema_id=siwc-source-export-state, version1.0.0, PENDING or RETIRED. Bindings stay child-only. Missing, invalid or disagreeing state never restores ACTIVE. No real-source storage premise is established here; require local NTFS and a storage stack honoring documented flush completions. If premise is unsupported/unestablished, refuse DURABILITY_UNESTABLISHED, no real export or weaker guarantee.

items.surface: Windows W1 first publication and generation replacement
items.before: Revision B left this Windows retirement/publication/restart ordering unspecified.
items.after: After retirement only, CREATE_NEW random protected write-through same-directory temp; full write/flush/ID/ACL/hash checks then close temp handle, retain parent handles/child lock. Same-volume MoveFileExW flags0x8 only: absent final, no replace/copy/reboot fallback. OPEN_EXISTING final share0 read/write/read-control no-follow/write-through; verify expected temp ID, link count, volume, owner/DACL, complete bound bytes; FlushFileBuffers/check and recheck retirement. DONE only after exclusive durable sanitized receipt; all ambiguity BLOCKED, no retry/cleanup/source reuse.
items.compatibility_requirement: Export and state records never replace. Before retirement only, existing admitted same-session credential update requires durable operation-pending barrier; prepared/verified/flushed replacement; close file handles but retain parents/lock; ReplaceFileW(target,replacement,NULL,0,NULL,NULL). No backup/ACL-ignore/unsupported write-through flag. Reopen/verify expected replacement ID, exact generation/bytes/ACL, FlushFileBuffers/check before existing commit. All partial/error outcomes retain pending and block, no assumption old bytes survived, retry/orphan/backup adoption. Linux unchanged.

items.surface: Windows W1 restart/refusal and failure model
items.before: Revision B left this Windows retirement/publication/restart ordering unspecified.
items.after: Matching RETIRED+PENDING always SOURCE_SESSION_RETIRED regardless of output/receipt; PENDING alone, invalid/unreadable/conflicting/missing expected state or interrupted replacement blocks EXPORT_STATE_INVALID. No tail skipping, prior-ACTIVE fallback, auto completion, republish, marker clearing or reactivation. Busy lock remains SESSION_BUSY. Recovery is outside WP, requires separate owner authorization; retain artifacts and emit closed code. Process death preserves OS; power loss may drop unacknowledged writes. Safety requires both acknowledged retirement barriers before any bundle byte.
items.compatibility_requirement: Actual new-code native R002/R003 tests: death at every pending/write/flush/retired/temp/move/final/receipt boundary, short writes, false API returns, sharing collisions, ReplaceFileW partial outcomes; zero early export, correct disk/ID/ACL state, no source reuse. Persistence schedules may lose only unacknowledged writes; losing acknowledged writes is an unsupported-device counterexample, not a PASS. Neither readback nor process kills prove hardware. Unconditional arbitrary-device power-loss durability is incompatible with frozen APIs/constraints; refuse rather than weaken. No physical probe, power cycle or new test node.

items.surface: Windows verified volume-root effective 0x4 ACE only
items.before: Generic ancestor guard rejects effective untrusted root FILE_ADD_SUBDIRECTORY along with other mutation bits.
items.after: Sole volume-root ACE clarification: an effective untrusted allow ACE may have 0x4 FILE_ADD_SUBDIRECTORY as its only otherwise-prohibited bit (mask & 0x500D0156 == 0x4) only on the independently handle-verified local NTFS volume-root directory, never an intermediate or private leaf. Read/traverse bits may coexist; no other old rejected bit is exempt, even beside 0x4: FILE_ADD_FILE 0x2, FILE_DELETE_CHILD 0x40, DELETE, WRITE_DAC, WRITE_OWNER, write-EA/attributes and GENERIC_WRITE/ALL still refuse. Inherit-only ACEs do not grant effective root rights and cannot establish this exception. Keep trusted owner/DACL validation and fail closed on unknown/unsupported ACEs or metadata. Never clear 0x4 from the universal ancestor mask or treat a caller boolean/path prefix as root proof.
items.compatibility_requirement: Root eligibility is per retained no-delete-share, no-follow directory handle: require GetDriveTypeW local fixed volume, GetVolumeInformationByHandleW NTFS/persistent ACLs, GetFinalPathNameByHandleW normalized VOLUME_NAME_GUID naming exactly the volume root (no relative suffix), and independently open that canonical GUID root with the same safe flags. Compare volume serial/file-index identities via GetFileInformationByHandle; all descendant handles must stay on that volume. Refuse missing/ambiguous/inconsistent results, drive/SUBST aliases to subdirectories, wrong-volume/root masquerade, mount/reparse points or excluded-root overlap. Only this proven root may provisionally pass its 0x4 ACE; no credential access, publication or success until the entire existing descendant chain, owner/SYSTEM-only protected private leaf, identities and locks pass unchanged.

items.expected_result: A single selected registration is the unit of handoff. Add OAuthPlanTransport.export_selected_session() and import_selected_session(); prepare_vm_host() creates only a stable destination host ID. Export runs under the source session lock, validates the native record/mapping and retained ID-token consistency, durably disables source use before producing one owner-only bundle. No whole-directory copy. Import requires a fresh empty credential slot with pre-existing destination host ID; never overwrites a slot or host ID. Preserve issued client_id, subject, issuer, full scopes, access/refresh/id tokens as one issued set; destination credential host metadata becomes its existing host ID, which must differ from source. Reject malformed/ambiguous/mixed registration, missing selected mapping/retained ID token, wrong issuer/audience/client/sub/scopes and source-equals-destination host before any network. A protected owner-supplied selection must match the transferred mapping, not email. Offline JWT payload consistency is not signature/entitlement verification: trust originates only in the source attended validated native login and owner-controlled secure transfer. No offline import may claim fresh OIDC validation. Import is allowed once; an existing target, consumed source or pending import refuses replay. Apply the affected native-phase/initial-login cases in the prompt narrow admission negative matrix; all earlier cases remain mandatory.

Production bridge is Windows source + Linux destination. Linux retains dir_fd, O_NOFOLLOW, O_DIRECTORY, flock and durable fsync; Windows source must satisfy the exact Windows Source Contract in this prompt and spec.api_matrix. Unsupported capabilities/filesystems return PLATFORM_UNSUPPORTED before credential access/network. Source is non-elevated Windows user; destination is one non-root uid. Validate lexical paths before resolve; reject repository, pin/release roots and overlapping source/destination/output roots. Owner supplies an approved storage root outside all repo/releases. Linux: walk using anchored no-follow descriptors; ancestors root/current-uid owned and not group/world writable, leaf current-uid 0700, regular files current-uid 0600, single link, bounded size. Windows: handle/ACL equivalents must meet the separately assessed contract; chmod is not an ACL test. Reject symlinks, reparse/junction semantics, hard links, FIFOs/devices, unsafe owners/modes and unsafe temp/final targets; never chmod/chown or delete existing user files to repair them. Use exclusive random same-directory private temp creation (Linux 0600, Windows protected DACL), flush/fsync and directory fsync on Linux, verified-descriptor publication; Windows checked Win32 flush/publication with fail-closed uncertainty as specified below; no fixed .tmp, no truncation of pre-existing files. New artifacts publish without replacement. An existing selected credential may be atomically replaced only by its validated same-session next generation under the lock. Multi-file import/login uses a durable pending marker; crash leaves an unusable blocked slot, never mixed usable state. Orphan temp files are not adopted or automatically deleted; exact repair requires later owner action. Threat model is owner-controlled immutable executable and local filesystem, not malicious root/same-uid tampering or hostile snapshot rollback. JSON limits: operator record 64 KiB, transfer 256 KiB, credential/registration/host records 256 KiB/16 KiB/4 KiB; maximum nesting 8, reject duplicate keys/nonfinite numbers. Positive native filesystem tests run as a non-root user under a private scratch root with safe ancestors; do not silently exempt writable /tmp ancestors or claim a root-owned fixture proves non-root storage. Apply Windows W1 retirement/publication/restart obligations in api_matrix: every real child-kill and API/persistence fault boundary, no secret-bearing temp before both flushed/verified barriers, source never reactivates; process-kill PASS is not power-loss evidence, unsupported acknowledged-write loss is not a valid storage premise. Apply the affected native-phase/initial-login cases in the prompt narrow admission negative matrix; all earlier cases remain mandatory. Apply the sole verified NTFS volume-root effective-0x4 clarification in the prompt and api_matrix; execute its bounded R002/R003 native/synthetic negative matrix. No intermediate/leaf, other mutation-bit, POSIX or W1 exemption; every refusal preserves source/other-file bytes and identities and publishes zero token bytes.

Use one fixed, securely opened never-unlinked lock file per selected credential slot: Linux nonblocking fcntl.flock; Windows source LockFileEx exclusive+fail-immediately. The credential child holds the lock throughout read/validate/mutate/remote phase. All native login/preflight/import/export/dispatch credential readers participate, including direct Python callers; no wrapper-only mutex. Busy returns SESSION_BUSY, never waits/retries. OS release after process death handles stale locks; never steal/unlink by timestamp or PID. Source export marks that session transferred-out before publication and all source real operations then stop. VM is the sole permitted refresh owner; owner must quiesce all source copies/external callers before handoff, which is an operational trust prerequisite rather than a distributed-lock claim. Write/fsync a refresh-pending marker before the one possible refresh request. Validate replacement issuer/audience/client/scopes and coherent identity before atomic commit; preserve old refresh only if a valid response legitimately omits its replacement and preserve retained ID token unless a newly supplied one is validated. Do not add a JWKS fetch to preflight; an unvalidated replacement ID token blocks locally. Mark commit complete durably before clearing pending. Crash/timeout/denial/invalid_grant/uncertain rotation leaves blocked pending state and no retry or rollback to the old token; no automatic deletion, recovery, second refresh, source resumption or reimport. A fresh explicit owner reauthorization/recovery decision is required. Returning attended login reuses the selected issued client and sends retained ID-token hint only to the fixed authorization endpoint, with fresh PKCE/state/nonce; never emit the URL. No logout/revocation manager is added. Apply Windows W1 retirement/publication/restart obligations in api_matrix: every real child-kill and API/persistence fault boundary, no secret-bearing temp before both flushed/verified barriers, source never reactivates; process-kill PASS is not power-loss evidence, unsupported acknowledged-write loss is not a valid storage premise. Apply the affected native-phase/initial-login cases in the prompt narrow admission negative matrix; all earlier cases remain mandatory.
